verified_current_state.fastapi_route: /api/metrics has no user or admin dependency
verified_current_state.edge_route: Caddy forwards all /api/* paths to FastAPI
verified_current_state.compose_network: ai-reader-api, ai-reader-worker, and Caddy share the external app network; environment aliases are api-staging and api-prod

recommended_design.name: edge deny plus existing internal app-network scrape
recommended_design.public_contract: An exact Caddy /api/metrics handler precedes the general /api/* handler and returns 404 in staging and production.
recommended_design.internal_contract: The environment's worker or an approved monitoring container reads http://api-staging:8000/api/metrics or http://api-prod:8000/api/metrics over the existing app network.
verification: Caddy config adapts and both Compose overlays render
internal worker-container GET returns 200 text/plain with expected metric families
public staging/prod GET returns 404 without capturing a response body
existing health, article, Admin, session, and smoke boundaries remain unchanged
recommended_design.rollback: Remove the exact Caddy handler and matching smoke assertions.

alternatives.name: FastAPI bearer token
alternatives.tradeoff: Supports remote Prometheus but introduces a new secret, rotation, configuration, and log-redaction surface.

alternatives.name: dedicated per-environment monitoring network and Prometheus
alternatives.tradeoff: Strongest isolation but adds an unrequested runtime service and operational scope before a monitoring requirement exists.

decision_required.known_residual_risk: The recommended existing-network design allows any container already attached to the shared app network to reach metrics; approval must confirm that this is an acceptable internal trust boundary.

limits: No Caddy, Compose, FastAPI, secret, or live environment was changed.
The internal scrape procedure cannot run locally because the Docker daemon is unavailable.
